perm_view_channel_desc: See channels and read new messages in them.
perm_manage_channels_desc: Create, edit, reorder and delete channels.
perm_manage_roles_desc: Create and edit roles below their highest role, assign them, and edit channel permissions.
perm_manage_guild_desc: Change the guild's name, icon, listing, system messages and public invite link, and see every invite.
perm_manage_expressions_desc: Add, rename and delete this guild's custom emoji and stickers.
perm_view_audit_log_desc: Read the record of changes made in this guild.
perm_create_invite_desc: Invite new people to this guild.
perm_kick_members_desc: Remove members below them. Kicked members can rejoin with an invite.
perm_ban_members_desc: Remove members below them for good, and manage the ban list.
perm_moderate_members_desc: Stop members below them from talking for a while.
perm_change_nickname_desc: Set their own nickname in this guild.
perm_manage_nicknames_desc: Change the nicknames of members below them.
perm_attach_files_desc: Upload images, videos and other files.
perm_mention_everyone_desc: Notify everyone who can see the channel.
perm_manage_messages_desc: Delete and pin other people's messages, and skip slowmode.
perm_administrator_desc: Every permission, ignoring channel overrides. Grant with care.
guild_listed_note: Anyone on this server can find and join it from Browse.
guild_unlisted_note: The server owner has turned off the public list, so this has no effect right now.
icon_hint_animated: Square images work best. GIFs stay animated.
banner_hint: Shown above the channel list and on invites (16:9).
banner_locked_allowlist: Guild banners need the guild owner to have perks on this server.
banner_locked_off: Guild banners are turned off on this server.
list_in_directory_label: List in the public guild directory
system_leave_label: Say when someone leaves (or is kicked or banned)
discard_changes_message: You changed this role but didn't save.
delete_role_message: Members lose it and any channel overrides for it. This can't be undone.
everyone_overrides_note: Overrides for everyone. To make a private channel, deny View channel here and allow it for some roles.
role_icons_locked_allowlist: need the guild owner to have perks.
role_icons_locked_off: are turned off on this server.
gradient_locked_allowlist: need the guild owner to have perks.
gradient_locked_off: are turned off on this server.
everyone_role_note: @everyone applies to every member of the guild.
hoist_perm_desc: Online members with this role get their own group in the member list.
role_locked_note: This role is at or above your highest role, so you can't edit it.
delete_guild_intro_before: This deletes every channel, message, role and invite in
delete_guild_intro_after: for everyone. It can't be undone.
remove_icon_body: The guild falls back to its initials.
remove_guild_banner_body: The image is deleted from the server.
remove_role_icon_body: Members with this role stop showing it beside their name.
unban_body: They'll be able to join this guild again with an invite.
delete_guild_confirm_body: Every channel, message and attachment in this guild is deleted. This can't be undone.
